title: Persist durable per-attempt resource authority
description: Prerequisite for task-6d40078159e84d92b3293d7b366cf727. Current measurement at HEAD a42ae2f: @moe/scheduler ResourceRow reducers are pure; daemon has no durable current resource writer/reader or attempt-to-resource membership. ClaimSuccessors and ActivationLedgerRecord discard ResourceRow[], and recovery inventory is only a recovery-window snapshot, not live release authority. Deliverable: one focused daemon persistence/application module that binds the complete ResourceRow set to project/attempt/effect at claim or activation, records RELEASED/QUARANTINED transitions only through production @moe/scheduler reducers, and exposes a strict complete current reader. Consumer: task-6d40078159e84d92b3293d7b366cf727.
definitionOfDone: The production claim/activation path durably binds the complete ResourceRow membership to projectId, attemptRef and effect intent; a later resource cannot disappear merely because its row is undecodable or nonterminal.
State transitions are persisted only from accepted public @moe/scheduler resource-reducer results, preserving RELEASED versus QUARANTINED; caller row lists, refs or states never become authority.

A current per-attempt reader canonical-byte-checks and replays the bound set, returning every member exactly once; ABSENT, UNREADABLE, MALFORMED and AMBIGUOUS are distinct stable codes with exact layers and grant no terminal authority.

Real-Sqlite tests cover multiple resources, one undecodable row, one nonterminal row, replay/conflicting bytes, ordering, foreign-project binding, zero residue, and one accepted production-writer control; failure assertions pin code and layer.
Raw event/decision counts prove exact replay is idempotent and conflicting bytes do not overwrite the original set; a generated hostile sweep asserts a nonzero case count.
Completion names task-6d40078159e84d92b3293d7b366cf727 as consumer and records its exact reader edge; daemon typecheck/test execute separately with nonzero test-count output.
taskRails: Use public @moe/scheduler resource reducers after verifying manifest, lock importer and compiled bare-specifier dependency edge; do not reimplement their transitions.
Recovery inventory is not current scheduler resource authority and must not be repurposed. No caller list/ref/state gains authority.
Membership must be complete and bounded; missing, duplicate, undecodable or foreign-project rows are UNKNOWN/refused, never skipped.
Use real SqliteEventStore, TDD exact codes/layers, target <=250 lines per production source, and commit only explicit owned paths.
